name: FAANG Generic Loop
blurb: A company-agnostic big-tech software loop: behavioral, coding, system design, and low-level design. A good default when prepping broadly.

rounds.title: Behavioral
rounds.focus: STAR-structured stories; individual contribution, tradeoffs, and outcomes.

rounds.title: Coding
rounds.focus: Correct, communicated, complexity-aware code; probe edge cases and data-structure choice.

rounds.title: System Design
rounds.focus: Requirements, data model, scale, and tradeoffs. Deep-dive one component.

rounds.title: Low-Level Design
rounds.focus: Class model, responsibilities, and extensibility; clean API boundaries.
